g.text: Free LLM vs. traditional methods | five seeds completed to 1005
Lower is better. All curves use verified frozen fits and the same initialization and validation split within each seed.
Historical seed 157/6101 retain Astra/high prefixes. Seeds 887/2357/12203 use Sol6.1/xhigh throughout.
Panel F compares the same five seeds at every budget (333–1005); validation only, no test evaluation.
